answers.why: Deborah judged the Israelite people at that time.
Kedesh is located in Naphtali's tribal territory.
The LORD is Israel's national God, commanding Barak to mobilize tribal troops.
Barak summoned Zebulun's tribal fighters to Kedesh.
Barak summoned Naphtali's tribal fighters, who joined his ten thousand men.
The song celebrates Israel's mobilization as the people volunteered.
Deborah praises the LORD as the God of the Israelite nation.
The LORD is called Israel's God in the account of his manifestation at Sinai.
Village life ceased among the Israelites before Deborah arose.
Deborah arose as a mother among the Israelite people.
The verse speaks of forty thousand people in Israel lacking shields and spears.
Israel has leaders who volunteered among the people.
The song recounts the LORD's righteous acts for Israel's villagers.
Ephraim supplies participants in the battle described by the song.
Men handling the writer's staff came from Zebulun.
Reuben's divisions deliberated while other tribes joined Deborah and Barak.
Reuben's divisions remained among the sheepfolds instead of joining the battle.
Asher remained in its coastal territory during the tribal mobilization.
Zebulun is explicitly called a people who risked their lives in battle.
Naphtali joined Zebulun in risking their lives on the battlefield.
